name: Brasidas Spellhardt
desc:
Brasidas Spellhardt is Lightborn found within [The Floating Keep](location:the_floating_keep). He is the Treasurer and [Antiquarian](entity:antiquarian) for the Keep and [Spellhardt family](faction:spellhardt_family).

He appears fond of metaphors to do with storms.

He wears a Red Megalodaunt Coat with the Pathfinder Thaumaturge Outfit underneath.
additional_info: -   Brasidas is a reference to Vergil from the _Devil May Cry_ franchise.
